title: [Bug] Queued messages not displayed in stream during focus mode
body:
**Bug Description**
in focus mode, queued messages don't appear in the stream when they do get submitted. everything appears to be working fine, it's just a display issue. they show up in the expected place when you're not in focus mode.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.97
- Feedback ID: e2f20b56-f3be-42e5-863a-360f8298e5d3

**Note:** Content was truncated.
author: allixsenos
